description: Version 6L of the INMOM (Institute of Numerical Mathematics Ocean Model) is a hydrostatic generalized spherical coordinates (the model South Pole located at the geographical South Pole, and the model North Pole located at a point (60N, 90E) in central Siberia) numerical ocean model with Boussinesq kinematics on an Arakawa C-grid. Vertical resolution is 40 sigma-levels. Coriolis term is treated implicitly at barotropic adaptation stage. Second order Adams-Bashforth scheme is used for scalars transport. Vertical mixing is parameterized according to Pacanowski and Philander (1981).
